hypothesis: Do learned continuous raw (observed sensor,action) features retain transfer and supervised memory over three previously distinct nonlinear families when the physical state is only partially observed? Test catastrophic interference after source→sine→rational→source replay, holding all evaluation worlds and calibration constant. Compare strong calibrated RBF-KRR, identical untrained features and trained recurrent GRU, with explicit fairness/cost limits.

environment.hidden_state: (x,z) two real physical dimensions, neither directly observed; sensor is scalar y=x+0.25*z; x and z not individually identifiable from a single sensor sample.
environment.observed_input: only y, applied u, numeric dt, measured noisy y_next; no x,z, family ID, switch marker, latent coefficient or analytic nonlinear feature given to predictor
environment.target: unobserved actual future y_next from fresh counterfactual u and dt
environment.query: last measured scalar sensor y, new continuous u and dt
environment.model_biases: models use numerical Euler residual (observed_next-observed)/dt and fixed-length 32-sample histories; no hidden law or latent sensor decomposition provided.
environment.difficulty_note: 2D latent dynamics and 1D sensor are intentionally partially observable, unlike S19's 1D fully observed world; success is not guaranteed.

arms.learned: S18 exact trained 2→32→12 tanh raw sensor/action feature map followed by differentiable per-world 12D ridge estimator
arms.untrained: Identical initial feature map never updated, same ridge
arms.gru: S18 exact 32-unit GRU with query-conditioned numeric readout, trained on same numerical worlds, steps and optimizer data
arms.conventional: Gaussian RBF kernel ridge over raw sensor/action values only, gamma/decay/ridge selected once from calibration-only source switching worlds
arms.oracle: hidden-state privileged exact y_next, used only to grade
arms.causal_ablation: replace post-switch 12 observed transitions with first 12 from same world, do not alter query or expected future y

calibration.tie_breaker: lowest calibration MSE then smaller gamma then larger decay then larger ridge

evaluation.cost_accounting: per-model training wall seconds, inference wall seconds per arm/family/phase, peak whole-process RSS, exact training step/world counts
evaluation.compute_fairness: trainable learned feature vs GRU match worlds and update counts, not parameters or FLOPs. Calibrated RBF-KRR untrained and no matched FLOP/energy; do NOT claim end-to-end compute-matched architectural superiority.

classification.report_primary: zero-shot cross-family under hidden state, after phase A
classification.report_sequential: retention after C, recovery after D, acquisition after B/C; independent flags even if primary zero-shot null
classification.no_grand_claim: No general intelligence, token-free text understanding, autonomous RSI, broad long-term cognition, independent science or physical analogue computation. Numerical fixed sampling and correct Euler numerical derivative prior are disclosed.

stop_conditions: weak calibrated baseline on frozen source
wall time or resident memory beyond cap
